column1: # domain-terms.tsv (harbor#1274, harbor#1149) - the workload vocabulary core must not carry: tools of a workload, not of harbor.
# Columns, tab-separated, one header row:  id  pattern  note
#   id       [a-z0-9-], unique; what domain-allow.tsv and the --list output name
#   pattern  an ERE, matched case-insensitively as a whole word (git grep -i -w -E)
#   note     why it is a workload term
# Read by bin/lint-domain.sh, which counts (core file, term) pairs and ratchets the count (CONTRACTS/lint-domain-baseline.txt).
# The leak gate (CONTRACTS/leak-patterns.tsv) is a different question: it finds who, this finds what.
# Seeded from the 2026-10-16 census on harbor#1273. Workload repo ids are not here: core cannot list them without naming them.
